subject: Literature in English
examFormat: The source file is only the WAEC harmonized list of prescribed Literature-in-English texts for WASSCE 2026-2030 and the full text of the prescribed poems; it does not state the papers, format, marks or duration.
excluded: Specific titles, authors and the full poem texts, because set texts change yearly and are described generically. No Ghana-only or other country-specific content appears in the file.

topics.name: Shakespearean Text
topics.content: Drama: one prescribed Shakespearean play on the WASSCE harmonized list of Literature-in-English texts for the current examination cycle.

topics.name: African Prose
objectives: Study the prescribed African prose texts
topics.content: Prose: set African novels chosen from the WASSCE harmonized list of Literature-in-English texts (two texts listed for the current cycle).

topics.name: Non-African Prose
objectives: Study the prescribed non-African prose texts
topics.content: Prose: set non-African novels chosen from the WASSCE harmonized list of Literature-in-English texts (two texts listed for the current cycle).

topics.name: African Drama
objectives: Study the prescribed African drama texts
topics.content: Drama: set African plays chosen from the WASSCE harmonized list of Literature-in-English texts (two texts listed for the current cycle).

topics.name: Non-African Drama
objectives: Study the prescribed non-African drama texts
topics.content: Drama: set non-African plays chosen from the WASSCE harmonized list of Literature-in-English texts (two texts listed for the current cycle).

topics.name: African Poetry
topics.content: Poetry: a list of prescribed African poems (six listed for the current cycle), whose full texts are reproduced in the WAEC list of prescribed poems.

topics.name: Non-African Poetry
topics.content: Poetry: a list of prescribed non-African poems (six listed for the current cycle, including one shortened narrative poem), whose full texts are reproduced in the WAEC list of prescribed poems.
